name: Sri Nachammai Cotton Mills Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Sri Nachammai Cotton Mills Ltd is in the business of manufacturing cotton yarns.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SNCML is a Tamil Nadu based company which 
manufactures cotton yarn in three varieties
-hosiery, warp, and hank-with counts 
ranging from 10-80s.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.59 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -13.6% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -17.4% over last 3 years.
